<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Restock" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/restock">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restock" name="Inventory Restock Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Inventory monitoring starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_ThresholdCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdCheck_Split" name="Threshold reached?" default="Flow_NoThreshold">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_ThresholdCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Split" name="Reorder signal type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThresholdReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToAutoAlert</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToManualCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToAutoAlert</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutoAlert_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual stock check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToManualCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ManualCheck_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Join" name="Reorder need signalled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutoAlert_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ManualCheck_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier (considering cost, delivery time and reliability)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOrder_Update</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates" name="Update inventory system with expected delivery dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOrder_Update</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_StockReceived" name="Stock received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_StockReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record received stock in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Shelve</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Shelve</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Shelve_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Shelve_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Inventory levels updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_ThresholdCheck" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck_Split" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel <= reorderThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoThreshold" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAutoAlert" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Split" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${alertMode == 'automated'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToManualCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Split" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${alertMode == 'manual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutoAlert_Join" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck_Join" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderSignal_Join" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_Update" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Receive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateDeliveryDates" targetRef="Event_StockReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_StockReceived" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Shelve" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelve_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description offers two alternative ways of performing the same signalling or checking step, joined by 'or', and both alternatives lead to the same next step: Model each alternative as its own task. Place an exclusive gateway before the alternatives, with one labelled outgoing flow per alternative, so that the choice of method is explicit. Join the alternatives with an exclusive merge gateway before the shared next step. Do not collapse the alternatives into one generic task, and do not leave either alternative without its choice gateway.
rules.situation: the description joins two alternative ways of handling an item with 'or' (for example, placing it in one of two locations), and the alternatives are the last handling of that item, so they do not both lead to a shared next step
